description: P2-M7-T01 numeric-epsilon golden spec on REAL material (committed). piston.cgr is a dev-only reference sample (never shipped, per 2026-10-16 licensing posture); nist_stc_06_asme1_V56R2023.CATPart is the public-domain NIST V5-6R2023 modern-era anchor (US Government test data, source recorded in docs/re-notes). When present under the corpus root / OEP_CGR_SAMPLES the golden must PASS within tolerance 1e-6, otherwise the row SKIPs (tolerant, never crashes). compare=numeric so any measured-count drift (even 1e-6) is a FAIL, not a silent pass.
